extracted.summary: Layla Haddad is house-hunting with a 3.5M max budget, needing at least 3 bedrooms, a pool, beach proximity and covered parking for 2 cars; her husband Karim must approve any purchase, a viewing was confirmed for 14 March, and she raised concerns about service charges. Layla stated requirements for covered parking for 2 cars, a ready-to-move-in property with no off-plan, and a home study; she flagged lease deadlines on 15/04/2026 and 30 June 2026, the rep committed to following up with the developer on a payment plan, and Layla mentioned she is a dentist with her own clinic. Layla is house-hunting with Karim: she needs a home study, a kitchen she can cook in, possibly a ground-floor room for Karim's mother next year, and nothing above the 20th floor; she plans to make the down payment once her bonus arrives in December. Mostly routine exchanges with Layla Haddad; she asked for property options in Arabian Ranches, raised a concern about a previous developer's 18-month handover delay, and noted she'll be away for personal travel in February. The rep committed to sending a snagging checklist before handover, and Layla said she'll sign once the bank approves by end of month. Layla continues to review listings and mentions she will be away traveling in February; she has conditional plans to sign if the bank approves by end of month and to decide after Eid, wants a property away from crowded areas and near the airport due to Karim's travel, and is unhappy paying 180k a year in rent; her sister Rania is also looking for a 1-bed near the Marina. Layla is house-hunting with Sam; she's frustrated paying 180k a year in rent, her daughter Noor starts KG2 in September affecting the school run, her father is helping with the down payment and wants to view properties, she will get a bank valuation report, and the rep will confirm a landlord matter by Wednesday. Extended WhatsApp exchange with Layla Haddad about an apartment search; Sam committed to confirming with the landlord by Wednesday, Layla raised concerns about a competing agent, a dark unit, and highway noise, noted Karim just wants a building with a gym, mentioned a colleague also looking for a 2-bed, and a vague future interest in a villa in Spain. Mostly low-content exchanges with Layla Haddad about property listings; she mentioned a colleague also looking for a 2-bed, wants to close before 1 September 2026, has a budget of 3.5 (stretchable to 3.8 per Karim), and shared personal notes about her mum's upcoming 60th birthday and Adam's aquarium visits. The rep promised to connect her with his mortgage broker this week. Mostly low-content exchanges with listing links; Layla raised a concern about a Damac Hills property's lack of shade, mentioned buying their first flat in JVC in 2019, noted Karim's contract here ends next summer with an uncertain future, and updated the requirement to 4 bedrooms since Karim's mother is moving in. Mostly filler chat; Layla updated her requirement to 4 bedrooms due to Karim's mum moving in, later also wants a small studio for Karim's mum as an investment, mentioned her pet Mishmish needing a balcony with a net, and jokingly referenced a 5M figure. Layla Haddad wants a small studio for Karim's mum as an investment, and she and her family will be away from 1 to 20 December 2026. The rep committed to checking the pool depth with the developer, sending three years of service charge history, and booking Karim's second viewing; Layla shared Karim's birthday and their anniversary dates, and mentioned they'll probably decide by year end, though not firmly. Mostly routine back-and-forth with no firm commitments; Layla mentioned Karim may decide by the end of the year but said not to count on it, and a meeting was confirmed for Thursday 12 November 2026 at 4pm at the office.
